description: This file contains helper functions and tests related to text encoding conversions, specifically for UTF-16 and UTF-32, using iconv and shell test functions.

methods.name: write_utf16
methods.description: Outputs the UTF-16 byte order mark if the prerequisite test 'NO_UTF16_BOM' passes, then converts input from UTF-8 to UTF-16.

methods.name: write_utf32
methods.description: Outputs the UTF-32 byte order mark if the prerequisite test 'NO_UTF32_BOM' passes, then converts input from UTF-8 to UTF-32.
